description: This file contains Bulgarian localization strings for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1, defining translated messages for various user interface prompts and notifications.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the user should delete a certain number of characters, in Bulgarian.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the user should input more characters, in Bulgarian.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message indicating more data is being loaded, in Bulgarian.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed, in Bulgarian.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message indicating no search results were found, in Bulgarian.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message indicating a search is in progress, in Bulgarian.
